verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that syncs run on a schedule or trigger you set, that data can sync on a recurring schedule or when data changes, and that each run reports its outcome, with alerts on failure. Syncs can be created and managed through the REST API and the official MCP server, which gives AI-native users a programmatic way to work with these recurring jobs. Missing for 10: detail on schedule types (cron/interval granularity), explicit evidence that schedules can be set via API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling.
